title: Meeting / Realtime Live-Provider Closure

consentFloor.refusalBlocked: consent_required + recording.blocked ledger event BEFORE any grant
consentFloor.grantStarted: a REAL egress started (EGRESS_STARTING) and JOINED the room as a real participant
consentFloor.revocationStopped: consent.revoked event STOPPED the recording (StopEgress -> EGRESS_ABORTED, recordingState 'recorded')

liveEvidence.secretsHygiene: API secret and every minted token REDACTED from all evidence files

newTestFiles.layer: LIVE (credential-gated; 16 live assertions + 1 explicit skip label)
harness (not collected; the live leg runner)
test helper (the killable LiveKit Twirp stub)

realtime.auth: per-call short-lived HS256 access tokens (iss=API key, scoped video grants)
realtime.signal: wss://…/rtc?access_token=… (join grants minted on demand; the agent worker's own media connection is the W112 frontier)
realtime.note: this deployment routes the livekit.RoomService prefix (the livekit.Room alias falls to the health responder on LiveKit Cloud)

meeting.provider: livekit (rooms) — the split the frozen contracts dictate
meeting.rationale: the meetings module's provider vocabulary (zoom/microsoft-teams/google-meet/recall) is frozen with DB CHECK constraints; LiveKit backs the MEETING surface through the realtime module's meeting_participation/meeting_companion session kinds, attached to the meetings module's canonical session through the validated opaque meetingSessionId reference (read through the meetings contract at start)
meeting.meetingReferenceEvidence: the live leg created the canonical meeting session through the meetings module production webhook ingestion path (zoom envelope, domain-side fixture by design) and the companion session attached to it

env: LIVEKIT_EGRESS_STREAM_URL (optional; unset -> recording control fails honestly provider_unavailable)
LIVEKIT_SIP_TRUNK_ID (optional; unset -> dial fails honestly provider_unavailable)
wiring.invocation: composed by the host at its realtime entry points (the resident worker is the W112 certification frontier); deterministic double remains available via setRealtimeTransport

environmentBlockedExceptions: recording FILE artifacts: LiveKit file egress requires an external storage destination (S3/GCP/Azure upload config) the operator project does not include — the egress CONTROL plane (start/stop/lifecycle, the egress joining the room as a real participant) IS live-proven; the stream destination rtmp://localhost:1935 is a black hole by design and the provider reports the failure honestly (EGRESS_ABORTED)

telephony SIP dial-out: the SIP feature is not enabled on the operator's LiveKit Cloud project (livekit.SIP/* answers 401 'permissions denied' with full admin grants) — dial fails honestly provider_unavailable without LIVEKIT_SIP_TRUNK_ID

WebRTC data-channel RECEIVE: the live client joins through the signal WebSocket (the work order's sanctioned @livekit/protocol + ws approach); receiving the SendData payload on an SCTP data channel requires a full WebRTC stack (real ASR/audio is the agents worker, W112)
migrations: NONE — durable session/artifact finalization and provider-failure evidence run on the existing W086 schema (realtime_sessions/events/turns/responses/artifacts + finalize_pending/finalize_run_id/evidence_observation_id)

dependencies.name: @livekit/protocol
dependencies.why: the work-order-sanctioned protobuf codec for the live leg's signal client (production code has ZERO new dependencies)

dependencies.name: ws
dependencies.why: the work-order-sanctioned WebSocket client with protocol-level keepalive for the live leg (production code has ZERO new dependencies)
